CREATE FUNCTION public.own_receipt_print_facts_v6_candidate_v1(record_value jsonb,capture jsonb,bank_fact jsonb,frozen_at text)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path=pg_catalog,public,pg_temp AS $v6facts$
DECLARE cid text:=record_value->>'contractId';saved jsonb:=capture->'saved';payload jsonb:=capture->'payload';
 input_value jsonb:=saved->'input';result_value jsonb:=saved->'result';population jsonb;employee jsonb;
 component jsonb;employment_row jsonb;row_value jsonb;other_employee jsonb;definition jsonb;
 units_value jsonb:='[]';concept jsonb;quantity jsonb;captured_quantities jsonb;destination jsonb;
 start_value jsonb:='null';category_value jsonb:='null';employment_hash jsonb:='null';n integer;
BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(record_value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR cid IS NULL
 OR cid !~ '^[a-f0-9]{8}(-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$'
 OR coalesce(record_value->>'runId','') !~ '^[a-f0-9]{8}(-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$'
 OR coalesce(record_value->>'registrationId','') !~ '^[a-f0-9]{8}(-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$'
 OR coalesce(input_value->>'period','') !~ '^(19|20)[0-9]{2}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'
 OR coalesce(input_value->>'liquidationType' IN('monthly','first_fortnight','sac','vacation','supplementary','final','other'),false) IS NOT TRUE
 OR jsonb_typeof(record_value->'inputVersion') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
 OR coalesce(record_value->>'inputVersion' IN('own-payroll-input.v4','own-payroll-input.v5'),false) IS NOT TRUE
 OR record_value->>'resultVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM replace(record_value->>'inputVersion','input','result')
 OR capture->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM record_value->>'runId'
 OR jsonb_typeof(payload) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(saved) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(input_value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(result_value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR payload->>'period' IS DISTINCT FROM input_value->>'period'
 OR payload->>'liquidationType' IS DISTINCT FROM input_value->>'liquidationType'
 OR result_value->>'period' IS DISTINCT FROM input_value->>'period'
 OR result_value->>'liquidationType' IS DISTINCT FROM input_value->>'liquidationType'
 OR input_value->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM record_value->>'inputVersion'
 OR result_value->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM record_value->>'resultVersion'
 OR capture->'payloadSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM record_value->'payloadSha256'
 OR saved->'inputSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM record_value->'inputSha256'
 OR saved->'resultSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM record_value->'resultSha256'
 OR capture->>'payloadSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.own_run_hash_v1(payload)
 OR saved->>'inputSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.own_run_hash_v1(input_value)
 OR saved->>'resultSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.own_run_hash_v1(result_value)
 OR jsonb_typeof(record_value->'concepts') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(record_value->'receiptRowKeys') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(record_value->'quantities') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(result_value->'quantities') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(payload#>'{population,employees}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR frozen_at IS NULL OR frozen_at !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{6}Z$'
 OR NOT pg_input_is_valid(frozen_at,'timestamp with time zone')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 IF to_char(frozen_at::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') IS DISTINCT FROM frozen_at
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 population:=payload#>'{population,employees}';
 SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM jsonb_array_elements(population) e WHERE e->>'contractId'=cid;
 IF n<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 SELECT e INTO employee FROM jsonb_array_elements(population) e WHERE e->>'contractId'=cid;
 IF employee->'employeeNumber' IS DISTINCT FROM record_value->'employeeNumber'
 OR employee->'agreementCode' IS DISTINCT FROM record_value->'agreementCode'
 OR employee->'departmentCode' IS DISTINCT FROM record_value->'departmentCode'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(q ORDER BY ord),'[]') INTO captured_quantities
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(result_value->'quantities') WITH ORDINALITY source_rows(q,ord) WHERE q->>'contractId'=cid;
 IF captured_quantities IS DISTINCT FROM record_value->'quantities'
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(record_value->'quantities') q GROUP BY q->>'conceptCode' HAVING count(*)<>1)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(record_value->'concepts') c GROUP BY c->>'code' HAVING count(*)<>1)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 FOR concept IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(record_value->'concepts') LOOP
  IF concept->>'nature' IS NULL OR concept->>'nature'='auxiliary' OR concept->>'code' IS NULL
  OR concept->>'code' !~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' OR NOT record_value->'receiptRowKeys' ? (cid||':concept:'||(concept->>'code'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
  SELECT q INTO quantity FROM jsonb_array_elements(record_value->'quantities') q WHERE q->>'contractId'=cid AND q->>'conceptCode'=concept->>'code';
  units_value:=units_value||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('rowKey',cid||':concept:'||(concept->>'code'),'quantity',coalesce(quantity,'null')));
 END LOOP;
 IF jsonb_array_length(units_value)<>jsonb_array_length(record_value->'receiptRowKeys') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 IF payload->'sourceInventory' ? 'periodClassifications' THEN
  component:=payload#>'{sourceInventory,periodClassifications}';
  IF public.own_program_exact_v1(component,ARRAY['version','complete','total','rows']) IS NOT TRUE
  OR component->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'own-period-classification-capture.v1'
  OR component->'complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR jsonb_typeof(component->'rows') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR component->'total' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(jsonb_array_length(population))
  OR jsonb_array_length(component->'rows')<>jsonb_array_length(population)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(component->'rows') x GROUP BY x->>'contractId' HAVING count(*)<>1)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(component->'rows') x GROUP BY x->>'registrationId' HAVING count(*)<>1)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
  FOR row_value IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(component->'rows') LOOP
   SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM jsonb_array_elements(population) e WHERE e->'contractId'=row_value->'contractId';
   IF n<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
   SELECT e INTO other_employee FROM jsonb_array_elements(population) e WHERE e->'contractId'=row_value->'contractId';
   BEGIN
    PERFORM public.own_period_classification_capture_row_v1(row_value,other_employee,payload->>'period');
   EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    IF SQLERRM='OWN_CLOSE_CONTRACT_INVALID' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;RAISE;
   END;
   IF row_value->>'contractId'=cid THEN employment_row:=row_value;END IF;
  END LOOP;
  IF employment_row IS NULL OR employment_row->'registrationId' IS DISTINCT FROM record_value->'registrationId'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
  definition:=employment_row->'definition';start_value:=definition->'startDate';category_value:=definition->'categoryCode';
  employment_hash:=to_jsonb(public.own_run_hash_v1(component));
 END IF;
 IF public.own_program_exact_v1(bank_fact,ARRAY['paymentDestination','bankConfigurationVersion','bankApprovalId']) IS NOT TRUE
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 destination:=bank_fact->'paymentDestination';
 IF destination='null'::jsonb THEN
  IF bank_fact->'bankConfigurationVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR bank_fact->'bankApprovalId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 ELSE
  IF public.own_program_exact_v1(destination,ARRAY['bankLabel','accountType','accountNumberMasked','currency','referenceDate']) IS NOT TRUE
  OR NOT public.own_receipt_text_v1(destination->'bankLabel',1,160)
  OR (destination->'accountType' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb AND
    (jsonb_typeof(destination->'accountType') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR coalesce(destination->>'accountType' IN('CA','CC'),false) IS NOT TRUE))
  OR jsonb_typeof(destination->'currency') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR coalesce(destination->>'currency' IN('ARS','USD'),false) IS NOT TRUE OR NOT public.own_bank_accounts_day_v1(destination->'referenceDate')
  OR (destination->'accountNumberMasked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb AND
    (NOT public.own_receipt_text_v1(destination->'accountNumberMasked',1,40)
     OR CASE WHEN char_length(destination->>'accountNumberMasked')<=4 THEN
       destination->>'accountNumberMasked' IS DISTINCT FROM repeat('*',char_length(destination->>'accountNumberMasked'))
      ELSE left(destination->>'accountNumberMasked',char_length(destination->>'accountNumberMasked')-4)
       IS DISTINCT FROM repeat('*',char_length(destination->>'accountNumberMasked')-4) END))
  OR jsonb_typeof(bank_fact->'bankConfigurationVersion') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR bank_fact->>'bankConfigurationVersion' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(bank_fact->'bankApprovalId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR bank_fact->>'bankApprovalId' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{8}(-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('version','own-receipt-print-facts.v1','frozenAt',frozen_at,'units',units_value,
  'employmentStartDate',start_value,'classification',jsonb_build_object('categoryCode',category_value,'categoryLabel',NULL,'jobTitle',NULL,'positionStructure',NULL),
  'paymentDestination',destination,'sources',jsonb_build_object('runId',record_value->>'runId','payloadSha256',record_value->>'payloadSha256',
  'inputSha256',record_value->>'inputSha256','resultSha256',record_value->>'resultSha256','employmentEvidenceSha256',employment_hash,
  'bankConfigurationVersion',bank_fact->'bankConfigurationVersion','bankApprovalId',bank_fact->'bankApprovalId'));
END $v6facts$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.own_receipt_print_facts_v6_candidate_v1(jsonb,jsonb,jsonb,text) OWNER TO neondb_owner;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.own_receipt_print_facts_v6_candidate_v1(jsonb,jsonb,jsonb,text) FROM PUBLIC,municontrol_actions_runtime_app;

CREATE FUNCTION public.own_receipt_bank_fact_v6_candidate_v1(ctx jsonb,target uuid,reference_date text)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path=pg_catalog,public,pg_temp AS $v6bank$
DECLARE empty_fact jsonb:=jsonb_build_object('paymentDestination',NULL,'bankConfigurationVersion',NULL,'bankApprovalId',NULL);
 configuration jsonb;approval public.own_bank_account_event;proposal public.own_bank_account_event;
 definition jsonb;validated jsonb;account jsonb;selected_count integer;masked text;expected_version text;
BEGIN
 IF reference_date IS NULL THEN RETURN empty_fact;END IF;
 IF target IS NULL OR NOT public.own_bank_accounts_day_v1(to_jsonb(reference_date))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 BEGIN
  PERFORM public.own_bank_accounts_read_lock_candidate_v1(ctx);
 EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_BUSY';
  WHEN OTHERS THEN IF SQLERRM='BANK_ACCOUNTS_BUSY' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_BUSY';END IF;RAISE;
 END;
 configuration:=public.own_bank_accounts_current_v1(ctx);
 IF public.own_program_exact_v1(configuration,ARRAY['version','revision','definition','proposalId','approvalId']) IS NOT TRUE
 OR jsonb_typeof(configuration->'version') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR configuration->>'version' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
 OR jsonb_typeof(configuration->'revision') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR configuration->>'revision' !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,3})$'
 OR (configuration->>'revision')::integer>1000
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 IF configuration->'revision'='0'::jsonb THEN
  expected_version:=public.own_run_hash_v1(jsonb_build_array('own-bank-accounts.v1',ctx->>'tenantId',ctx->>'sourceBindingId',0,NULL,NULL));
  IF configuration->'definition' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR configuration->'proposalId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
  OR configuration->'approvalId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR configuration->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_version
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;RETURN empty_fact;
 END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(configuration->'approvalId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR configuration->>'approvalId' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{8}(-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$'
 OR jsonb_typeof(configuration->'proposalId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR configuration->>'proposalId' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{8}(-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO approval FROM public.own_bank_account_event e WHERE e.id=(configuration->>'approvalId')::uuid
  AND e.command='approve' AND e.tenant_id=(ctx->>'tenantId')::uuid AND e.source_binding_id=(ctx->>'sourceBindingId')::uuid;
 SELECT * INTO proposal FROM public.own_bank_account_event e WHERE e.id=(configuration->>'proposalId')::uuid
  AND e.command='propose' AND e.tenant_id=(ctx->>'tenantId')::uuid AND e.source_binding_id=(ctx->>'sourceBindingId')::uuid;
 IF approval.id IS NULL OR proposal.id IS NULL OR approval.proposal_id IS DISTINCT FROM proposal.id
 OR approval.revision IS DISTINCT FROM (configuration->>'revision')::integer
 OR approval.request_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.own_run_hash_v1(approval.body)
 OR proposal.request_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.own_run_hash_v1(proposal.body)
 OR approval.body->>'command' IS DISTINCT FROM 'approve' OR proposal.body->>'command' IS DISTINCT FROM 'propose'
 OR approval.body->>'proposalId' IS DISTINCT FROM proposal.id::text
 OR approval.body->>'proposalSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM proposal.request_sha256
 OR approval.body->'baseVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM proposal.body->'baseVersion'
 OR approval.body->'sourceVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM proposal.body->'sourceVersion'
 OR proposal.source_snapshot->'version' IS DISTINCT FROM proposal.body->'sourceVersion'
 OR approval.source_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM proposal.source_snapshot
 OR public.own_program_exact_v1(approval.body,ARRAY['command','scopeVersion','baseVersion','sourceVersion','proposalId','proposalSha256','definition','reason','reviewConfirmed']) IS NOT TRUE
 OR public.own_program_exact_v1(proposal.body,ARRAY['command','scopeVersion','baseVersion','sourceVersion','proposalId','proposalSha256','definition','reason','reviewConfirmed']) IS NOT TRUE
 OR approval.body->'reviewConfirmed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
 OR approval.body->'definition' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
 OR proposal.body->'reviewConfirmed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
 OR proposal.body->'proposalId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
 OR proposal.body->'proposalSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
 OR approval.actor_membership_id=proposal.actor_membership_id OR approval.actor_person_id=proposal.actor_person_id
 OR approval.actor_email=proposal.actor_email OR configuration->'definition' IS DISTINCT FROM proposal.body->'definition'
 OR approval.receipt->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'own-bank-accounts.v1'
 OR approval.receipt->>'eventId' IS DISTINCT FROM approval.id::text
 OR approval.receipt->>'proposalId' IS DISTINCT FROM proposal.id::text
 OR approval.receipt->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'approved' OR approval.receipt->'body' IS DISTINCT FROM approval.body
 OR approval.receipt->>'requestSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM approval.request_sha256
 OR approval.receipt->'revision' IS DISTINCT FROM configuration->'revision'
 OR approval.receipt->'transferGenerated' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR approval.receipt->'paymentExecuted' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 IF public.own_program_exact_v1(proposal.source_snapshot,ARRAY['version','contracts']) IS NOT TRUE
 OR jsonb_typeof(proposal.source_snapshot->'contracts') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_array_length(proposal.source_snapshot->'contracts')>10000
 OR proposal.source_snapshot->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM public.own_run_hash_v1(jsonb_build_array(
  'own-bank-accounts.v1',ctx->>'tenantId',ctx->>'sourceBindingId',proposal.source_snapshot-'version'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 definition:=proposal.body->'definition';
 expected_version:=public.own_run_hash_v1(jsonb_build_array('own-bank-accounts.v1',ctx->>'tenantId',ctx->>'sourceBindingId',approval.revision,approval.id,definition));
 IF configuration->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_version OR approval.receipt->>'configurationVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_version
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 BEGIN
  -- Validate against the approved proposal's frozen source, never today's roster.
  validated:=public.own_bank_accounts_definition_v1(definition,proposal.source_snapshot,proposal.base_definition);
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  IF SQLERRM LIKE 'BANK_ACCOUNTS_%' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;RAISE;
 END;
 IF validated IS DISTINCT FROM definition THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO selected_count FROM jsonb_array_elements(definition->'accounts') a
 WHERE lower(a->>'contractId')=target::text AND a->>'status'='enabled'
 AND a->>'paymentChannelVersion'='own-bank-payment-channel.v1' AND a->>'paymentChannel'='bank_payroll'
 AND a->>'validFrom'<=reference_date AND (a->'validUntil'='null'::jsonb OR a->>'validUntil'>=reference_date);
 IF selected_count>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 IF selected_count=0 THEN RETURN empty_fact;END IF;
 SELECT a INTO account FROM jsonb_array_elements(definition->'accounts') a
 WHERE lower(a->>'contractId')=target::text AND a->>'status'='enabled'
 AND a->>'paymentChannelVersion'='own-bank-payment-channel.v1' AND a->>'paymentChannel'='bank_payroll'
 AND a->>'validFrom'<=reference_date AND (a->'validUntil'='null'::jsonb OR a->>'validUntil'>=reference_date);
 IF NOT public.own_receipt_text_v1(account->'bankLabel',1,160)
 OR (account->'accountNumber' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb AND NOT public.own_receipt_text_v1(account->'accountNumber',1,40))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 masked:=CASE WHEN account->'accountNumber'='null'::jsonb THEN NULL
  WHEN char_length(account->>'accountNumber')<=4 THEN repeat('*',char_length(account->>'accountNumber'))
  ELSE repeat('*',char_length(account->>'accountNumber')-4)||right(account->>'accountNumber',4) END;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('paymentDestination',jsonb_build_object('bankLabel',account->'bankLabel','accountType',account->'accountType',
  'accountNumberMasked',masked,'currency',account->'currency','referenceDate',reference_date),
  'bankConfigurationVersion',configuration->'version','bankApprovalId',configuration->'approvalId');
END $v6bank$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.own_receipt_bank_fact_v6_candidate_v1(jsonb,uuid,text) OWNER TO neondb_owner;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.own_receipt_bank_fact_v6_candidate_v1(jsonb,uuid,text) FROM PUBLIC,municontrol_actions_runtime_app;

CREATE FUNCTION public.own_receipt_v6_bank_pins_current_candidate_v1(ctx jsonb,snapshot_value jsonb)
RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path=pg_catalog,public,pg_temp AS $v6pins$
DECLARE r jsonb;facts jsonb;observed jsonb;expected jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF snapshot_value->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'own-receipt-snapshot.v6' THEN RETURN true;END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(snapshot_value->'records') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 FOR r IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot_value->'records') LOOP
  IF r->>'inputVersion' IN('own-payroll-input.v4','own-payroll-input.v5') THEN
   facts:=r->'printFacts';
   IF public.own_program_exact_v1(facts,ARRAY['version','frozenAt','units','employmentStartDate','classification','paymentDestination','sources']) IS NOT TRUE
   OR facts->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'own-receipt-print-facts.v1'
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
   IF facts->'paymentDestination'='null'::jsonb THEN
    IF facts#>'{sources,bankConfigurationVersion}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR facts#>'{sources,bankApprovalId}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
   END IF;
   -- Compare the complete expected fact even when no destination was captured.
   -- The reader returns the same three nulls when paymentDate is explicitly null.
   expected:=jsonb_build_object('paymentDestination',facts->'paymentDestination',
    'bankConfigurationVersion',facts#>'{sources,bankConfigurationVersion}','bankApprovalId',facts#>'{sources,bankApprovalId}');
   observed:=public.own_receipt_bank_fact_v6_candidate_v1(ctx,(r->>'contractId')::uuid,snapshot_value#>>'{params,paymentDate}');
   IF observed IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RETURN false;END IF;
  ELSIF r ? 'printFacts' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN true;
END $v6pins$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.own_receipt_v6_bank_pins_current_candidate_v1(jsonb,jsonb) OWNER TO neondb_owner;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.own_receipt_v6_bank_pins_current_candidate_v1(jsonb,jsonb) FROM PUBLIC,municontrol_actions_runtime_app;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.own_receipt_snapshot_v1(ctx jsonb, params jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE g public.own_payroll_close_event;c public.own_payroll_run_capture;employee jsonb;line jsonb;item jsonb;identity_row record;record_value jsonb;concepts jsonb;records jsonb:='[]';sources jsonb:='[]';n integer;concept_count integer:=0;result_value jsonb;subject jsonb;has_adopted boolean:=false;ns boolean;has_namespaced boolean:=false;has_official boolean:=false;has_emission boolean:=false;run_result public.own_payroll_run_result;original_capture jsonb;verified_runs jsonb:='{}';BEGIN
 PERFORM public.own_receipt_params_v1(params);PERFORM public.own_run_lock_v1(ctx);
 LOCK TABLE public.person_identity,public.employment_contract,public.native_employee_registration,public.employment_adoption_application,public.employment_adoption_decision,public.employment_adoption_proposal IN SHARE MODE NOWAIT;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(params->'contracts','[]')) chosen WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.own_payroll_close_event e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.snapshot->'employees') e_row(value) WHERE e.tenant_id=(ctx->>'tenantId')::uuid AND e.source_binding_id=(ctx->>'sourceBindingId')::uuid AND e.period=params->>'period' AND params->'types' ? e.liquidation_type AND e.command='close' AND e_row.value->>'contractId'=chosen AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.own_payroll_close_event r WHERE r.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND r.source_binding_id=e.source_binding_id AND r.group_id=e.id AND r.command='reopen'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_SELECTION_INVALID';END IF;
 FOR g IN SELECT e.* FROM public.own_payroll_close_event e WHERE e.tenant_id=(ctx->>'tenantId')::uuid AND e.source_binding_id=(ctx->>'sourceBindingId')::uuid AND e.period=params->>'period' AND params->'types' ? e.liquidation_type AND e.command='close' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.own_payroll_close_event r WHERE r.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND r.source_binding_id=e.source_binding_id AND r.group_id=e.id AND r.command='reopen') ORDER BY e.liquidation_type,e.id LOOP
  IF g.snapshot_sha256<>public.own_run_hash_v1(g.snapshot) OR g.snapshot->>'version' NOT IN('own-close-snapshot.v1','own-close-snapshot.v2','own-close-snapshot.v3','own-close-snapshot.v4','own-close-snapshot.v5') OR g.snapshot->>'period'<>g.period OR g.snapshot->>'liquidationType'<>g.liquidation_type OR jsonb_array_length(g.snapshot->'employees')<>(g.snapshot->>'employeeCount')::integer OR jsonb_array_length(g.snapshot->'concepts')<>(g.snapshot->>'conceptCount')::integer THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;n:=0;
  FOR employee IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(g.snapshot->'employees') ORDER BY CASE WHEN value->>'employeeNumber'~'^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN(value->>'employeeNumber')::numeric END,(CASE WHEN value->>'employeeNumber'~'^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN NULL ELSE value->>'employeeNumber' END) COLLATE "C",value->>'contractId' LOOP
   IF jsonb_array_length(coalesce(params->'contracts','[]'))>0 AND NOT params->'contracts' ? (employee->>'contractId') THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['agreement','department'],ARRAY['agreementCode','departmentCode']) f(range_key,field_key) WHERE nullif(params#>>ARRAY['filters',range_key||'From'],'')::numeric>(employee->>field_key)::numeric OR nullif(params#>>ARRAY['filters',range_key||'To'],'')::numeric<(employee->>field_key)::numeric) THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
   IF employee->>'employeeNumber' IS NULL OR length(employee->>'employeeNumber') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 64 OR employee->>'employeeNumber'~'[[:cntrl:]]' OR employee->>'employeeNumber'~E'[\u0080-\u009f]' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED';END IF;
   IF coalesce(params#>>'{filters,employeeFrom}','')<>'' OR coalesce(params#>>'{filters,employeeTo}','')<>'' THEN
    IF employee->>'employeeNumber'!~'^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_RANGE_INVALID';END IF;
    IF nullif(params#>>'{filters,employeeFrom}','')::numeric>(employee->>'employeeNumber')::numeric OR nullif(params#>>'{filters,employeeTo}','')::numeric<(employee->>'employeeNumber')::numeric THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
   END IF;
   SELECT pi.id AS person_id,pi.full_name,pi.dni,pi.cuil,reg.id AS registration_id INTO identity_row FROM public.native_employee_registration reg JOIN public.employment_contract ec ON ec.id=reg.contract_id AND ec.person_id=reg.person_id AND ec.tenant_id=reg.tenant_id AND ec.source_system='MUNICONTROL' AND ec.source_batch_id IS NULL JOIN public.person_identity pi ON pi.id=reg.person_id WHERE reg.contract_id=(employee->>'contractId')::uuid AND reg.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND reg.source_binding_id=g.source_binding_id;
   IF NOT FOUND OR NOT public.own_receipt_text_v1(to_jsonb(identity_row.full_name),3,160) OR coalesce(identity_row.dni,'')!~'^[0-9]{5,12}$' OR coalesce(identity_row.cuil,'')!~'^[0-9]{11}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED';END IF;
   SELECT * INTO c FROM public.own_payroll_run_capture WHERE id=(employee->>'runId')::uuid AND tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND source_binding_id=g.source_binding_id;
   IF c.id IS NULL OR c.payload_sha256<>public.own_run_hash_v1(c.payload) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
   IF g.snapshot->>'version' IN('own-close-snapshot.v4','own-close-snapshot.v5') AND employee->>'inputVersion' IN('own-payroll-input.v4','own-payroll-input.v5') THEN
    SELECT * INTO run_result FROM public.own_payroll_run_result WHERE capture_id=c.id;
    IF run_result.capture_id IS NULL OR run_result.algorithm_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM c.algorithm_sha256
    OR c.payload->>'period' IS DISTINCT FROM g.period OR c.payload->>'liquidationType' IS DISTINCT FROM g.liquidation_type
    OR run_result.input->>'period' IS DISTINCT FROM g.period OR run_result.input->>'liquidationType' IS DISTINCT FROM g.liquidation_type
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_ORIGINAL_RESULT_REQUIRED';END IF;
    original_capture:=jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'payload',c.payload,'payloadSha256',c.payload_sha256,'saved',public.own_run_saved_v1(run_result));
    IF NOT verified_runs ? c.id::text THEN
     PERFORM public.own_close_official_capture_check_candidate_v1(original_capture,g.period,g.liquidation_type);
     verified_runs:=verified_runs||jsonb_build_object(c.id::text,true);
    END IF;
   END IF;
   subject:=public.payroll_fixed_registry_subject_v2(ctx||jsonb_build_object('certifiedBindingId',ctx->>'sourceBindingId'),(employee->>'contractId')::uuid,true);
    IF subject->>'personId' IS DISTINCT FROM identity_row.person_id::text OR subject#>>'{subject,registrationId}' IS DISTINCT FROM identity_row.registration_id::text OR subject#>>'{subject,legajo}' IS DISTINCT FROM employee->>'employeeNumber' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.payload#>'{population,employees}') captured WHERE captured->>'contractId'=employee->>'contractId' AND captured->>'identityToken'=subject#>>'{subject,identityToken}' AND captured->>'employeeNumber'=employee->>'employeeNumber') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED';END IF;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.employment_adoption_application WHERE contract_id=(employee->>'contractId')::uuid) THEN has_adopted:=true;END IF;concepts:='[]';ns:=coalesce(c.payload#>>'{programState,program,definition,namespaceVersion}'='own-payroll-namespaces.v2',false);has_namespaced:=has_namespaced OR ns;
   FOR line IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(g.snapshot->'concepts') WHERE value->>'contractId'=employee->>'contractId' ORDER BY(value->>'conceptCode')::numeric LOOP
    SELECT x.value INTO item FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.payload#>'{programState,salaryCatalog,items}') x WHERE x.value->>'kind'=CASE WHEN ns AND line->>'nature'='auxiliary' THEN 'auxiliary' ELSE 'concept' END AND x.value->>'code'=line->>'conceptCode' AND x.value->>'agreementCode'=employee->>'agreementCode' AND x.value->'active'='true'::jsonb AND x.value->>'validFrom'<=g.period AND(x.value->'validUntil'='null'::jsonb OR x.value->>'validUntil'>=g.period);
    IF item IS NULL OR(SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.payload#>'{programState,salaryCatalog,items}') x WHERE x.value->>'kind'=CASE WHEN ns AND line->>'nature'='auxiliary' THEN 'auxiliary' ELSE 'concept' END AND x.value->>'code'=line->>'conceptCode' AND x.value->>'agreementCode'=employee->>'agreementCode' AND x.value->'active'='true'::jsonb AND x.value->>'validFrom'<=g.period AND(x.value->'validUntil'='null'::jsonb OR x.value->>'validUntil'>=g.period))<>1 OR NOT public.own_receipt_text_v1(item->'label',1,240) OR item->>'nature'<>line->>'nature' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_LABEL_REQUIRED';END IF;
    concepts:=concepts||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code',line->>'conceptCode','label',item->>'label','nature',line->>'nature','unit',line->>'unit','amount',line->>'amount','labelSourceSha256',c.payload_sha256));
   END LOOP;
   IF jsonb_array_length(concepts)<>(employee->>'conceptCount')::integer OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(records) old JOIN jsonb_array_elements(sources) source ON source.value->>'id'=old.value->>'sourceGroupId' WHERE source.value->>'type'=g.liquidation_type AND old.value->>'contractId'=employee->>'contractId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
   record_value:=jsonb_build_object('sourceGroupId',g.id,'contractId',employee->>'contractId','personId',identity_row.person_id,'registrationId',identity_row.registration_id,'employeeNumber',employee->>'employeeNumber','name',identity_row.full_name,'dni',identity_row.dni,'cuil',identity_row.cuil,'agreementCode',employee->>'agreementCode','departmentCode',employee->>'departmentCode','runId',employee->>'runId','liquidationVersion',employee->'liquidationVersion','precision',employee->'precision','totals',(employee->'totals')-'contractId','concepts',concepts);
   IF ns THEN record_value:=record_value||jsonb_build_object('namespaceVersion','own-payroll-namespaces.v2');END IF;
   IF g.snapshot->>'version' IN('own-close-snapshot.v4','own-close-snapshot.v5') AND employee->>'inputVersion' IN('own-payroll-input.v4','own-payroll-input.v5') THEN
    has_official:=true;has_emission:=has_emission OR employee->>'inputVersion'='own-payroll-input.v5';
    record_value:=public.own_receipt_official_record_candidate_v1(record_value,g.snapshot,employee,original_capture);
    record_value:=record_value||jsonb_build_object('printFacts',public.own_receipt_print_facts_v6_candidate_v1(record_value,original_capture,
     public.own_receipt_bank_fact_v6_candidate_v1(ctx,(record_value->>'contractId')::uuid,params->>'paymentDate'),
     to_char(g.recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')));
    concepts:=record_value->'concepts';
   END IF;
   records:=records||jsonb_build_array(record_value);n:=n+1;concept_count:=concept_count+jsonb_array_length(concepts);
   IF jsonb_array_length(records)>20000 OR concept_count>250000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_LIMIT';END IF;
  END LOOP;
  sources:=sources||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id',g.id,'snapshotSha256',g.snapshot_sha256,'period',g.period,'type',g.liquidation_type,'employeeCount',g.snapshot->'employeeCount','populationCount',g.snapshot->'populationCount','selectedCount',n));IF jsonb_array_length(sources)>1000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_LIMIT';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 result_value:=jsonb_build_object('version',CASE WHEN has_official THEN 'own-receipt-snapshot.v6' WHEN has_namespaced THEN 'own-receipt-snapshot.v3' WHEN has_adopted OR params ? 'contracts' THEN 'own-receipt-snapshot.v2' ELSE 'own-receipt-snapshot.v1' END,'params',params,'sourceVersion',public.own_receipt_source_version_v1(ctx,params),'sources',sources,'records',records,'recordCount',jsonb_array_length(records),'conceptCount',concept_count,'identityBasis',CASE WHEN has_namespaced OR has_adopted OR params ? 'contracts' THEN 'owned_registration_verified_at_capture' ELSE 'native_registration_immutable' END,'paymentDateBasis','declared','signatureState','pending','payrollPosted',false,'paymentExecuted',false);
 IF has_official THEN result_value:=result_value||jsonb_build_object('economicConceptCount',(SELECT coalesce(sum(coalesce((x->>'economicConceptCount')::integer,jsonb_array_length(x->'concepts'))),0) FROM jsonb_array_elements(records) x),'omittedRowCount',(SELECT coalesce(sum(coalesce((x->>'omittedRowCount')::integer,0)),0) FROM jsonb_array_elements(records) x));IF (result_value->>'economicConceptCount')::integer>250000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_LIMIT';END IF;END IF;
 IF octet_length(result_value::text)>33546240 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_LIMIT';END IF;RETURN result_value;
END $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.own_receipt_batch_value_v1(ctx jsonb,e public.own_payroll_receipt_event) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public,pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE r public.own_payroll_receipt_event;state_value text:='prepared';current_value boolean;independent boolean;bank_current boolean:=true;BEGIN
 IF e.id IS NULL OR e.command<>'prepare' OR e.snapshot_sha256<>public.own_run_hash_v1(e.snapshot) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO r FROM public.own_payroll_receipt_event WHERE tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND source_binding_id=e.source_binding_id AND batch_id=e.id AND command<>'prepare' ORDER BY CASE command WHEN 'withdraw' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1;
 IF r.id IS NOT NULL THEN state_value:=CASE r.command WHEN 'approve' THEN 'approved' ELSE 'withdrawn' END;END IF;
 IF state_value='prepared' AND e.snapshot->>'version'='own-receipt-snapshot.v6' THEN bank_current:=public.own_receipt_v6_bank_pins_current_candidate_v1(ctx,e.snapshot);END IF;
 current_value:=e.snapshot->>'sourceVersion'=public.own_receipt_source_version_v1(ctx,e.snapshot->'params');independent:=e.actor_membership_id IS DISTINCT FROM(ctx->>'membershipId')::uuid AND e.actor_person_id IS DISTINCT FROM(ctx->>'actorPersonId')::uuid AND e.actor_email IS DISTINCT FROM ctx->>'actorEmail';
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('version','own-receipt-batch.v1','id',e.id,'preparedAt',e.recorded_at,'preparedBy',e.actor_label,'snapshot',e.snapshot,'snapshotSha256',e.snapshot_sha256,'state',state_value,'sourceCurrent',current_value,'review',CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'decision',state_value,'at',r.recorded_at,'by',r.actor_label,'reason',r.body->>'reason') END,'permissions',jsonb_build_object('canApprove',state_value='prepared' AND current_value AND bank_current AND independent AND public.action_center_context_has_capability(ctx,'payroll.receipt.approve'),'canWithdraw',state_value<>'withdrawn' AND public.action_center_context_has_capability(ctx,'payroll.receipt.approve'),'canDownload',state_value<>'withdrawn' AND current_value));
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.own_receipt_command_v1(p jsonb,body jsonb,key uuid) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public,pg_temp SET timezone='UTC' AS $$
DECLARE ctx jsonb;e public.own_payroll_receipt_event;prepared public.own_payroll_receipt_event;s jsonb;view_value jsonb;id_value uuid:=gen_random_uuid();batch_value uuid;hash_value text;fingerprint text;val text;BEGIN
 IF NOT (public.own_program_exact_v1(body,ARRAY['command','scopeVersion','sourceVersion','params','batchId','batchSha256','reason','reviewConfirmed']) OR public.own_program_exact_v1(body,ARRAY['command','scopeVersion','sourceVersion','params','batchId','batchSha256','reason','reviewConfirmed','previewSha256'])) OR jsonb_typeof(body->'command') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR body->>'command' NOT IN('prepare','approve','withdraw') OR NOT public.own_receipt_text_v1(body->'reason',10,1000) OR octet_length(body::text)>16384 OR key IS NULL OR key::text!~'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-4[a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_INPUT_INVALID';END IF;
 IF body ? 'previewSha256' AND (body->>'command' IS DISTINCT FROM 'prepare' OR jsonb_typeof(body->'previewSha256') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR body->>'previewSha256' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_INPUT_INVALID';END IF;
 FOREACH val IN ARRAY ARRAY['scopeVersion','sourceVersion'] LOOP IF jsonb_typeof(body->val) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR body->>val!~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_INPUT_INVALID';END IF;END LOOP;
 ctx:=public.own_receipt_context_v1(p,body->>'command');PERFORM public.own_run_lock_v1(ctx);fingerprint:=public.own_run_hash_v1(body);
 SELECT * INTO e FROM public.own_payroll_receipt_event WHERE tenant_id=(ctx->>'tenantId')::uuid AND source_binding_id=(ctx->>'sourceBindingId')::uuid AND actor_membership_id=(ctx->>'membershipId')::uuid AND request_key=key;
 IF FOUND THEN IF e.actor_person_id IS DISTINCT FROM(ctx->>'actorPersonId')::uuid OR e.actor_email IS DISTINCT FROM ctx->>'actorEmail' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_FORBIDDEN';END IF;IF e.body<>body OR e.body_sha256<>fingerprint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_IDEMPOTENCY_REUSE';END IF;RETURN public.own_receipt_event_v1(e,true);END IF;
 IF body->>'scopeVersion'<>public.native_salary_scope_v1(ctx) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_STATE_CHANGED';END IF;
 IF body->>'command'='prepare' THEN
  IF body->'reviewConfirmed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR body->'batchId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR body->'batchSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_INPUT_INVALID';END IF;
  s:=public.own_receipt_snapshot_v1(ctx,body->'params');IF s->>'sourceVersion'<>body->>'sourceVersion' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_STATE_CHANGED';END IF;
  IF s->>'version'='own-receipt-snapshot.v6' THEN
   IF NOT body ? 'previewSha256' OR body->>'previewSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.own_run_hash_v1(s) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_STATE_CHANGED';END IF;
  ELSIF body ? 'previewSha256' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_INPUT_INVALID';END IF;IF(s->>'recordCount')::integer=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_EMPTY';END IF;batch_value:=id_value;hash_value:=public.own_run_hash_v1(s);
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.own_payroll_receipt_event old WHERE old.tenant_id=(ctx->>'tenantId')::uuid AND old.source_binding_id=(ctx->>'sourceBindingId')::uuid AND old.command='prepare' AND old.snapshot_sha256=hash_value AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.own_payroll_receipt_event r WHERE r.batch_id=old.id AND r.command='withdraw')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_DUPLICATE';END IF;
 ELSE
  IF body->'reviewConfirmed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR body->'params' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR jsonb_typeof(body->'batchId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR body->>'batchId'!~'^[a-f0-9]{8}(-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$' OR jsonb_typeof(body->'batchSha256') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR body->>'batchSha256'!~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_INPUT_INVALID';END IF;
  batch_value:=(body->>'batchId')::uuid;SELECT * INTO prepared FROM public.own_payroll_receipt_event WHERE id=batch_value AND tenant_id=(ctx->>'tenantId')::uuid AND source_binding_id=(ctx->>'sourceBindingId')::uuid AND command='prepare';IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND';END IF;
  IF body->>'command'='withdraw' AND prepared.snapshot->>'version'='own-receipt-snapshot.v6' THEN
   IF prepared.snapshot_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.own_run_hash_v1(prepared.snapshot) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_CONTRACT_INVALID';END IF;
   view_value:=jsonb_build_object('permissions',jsonb_build_object('canWithdraw',
    NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.own_payroll_receipt_event w WHERE w.tenant_id=prepared.tenant_id AND w.source_binding_id=prepared.source_binding_id AND w.batch_id=prepared.id AND w.command='withdraw')
    AND public.action_center_context_has_capability(ctx,'payroll.receipt.approve')));
  ELSE view_value:=public.own_receipt_batch_value_v1(ctx,prepared);END IF;hash_value:=prepared.snapshot_sha256;
  IF hash_value<>body->>'batchSha256' OR prepared.snapshot->>'sourceVersion'<>body->>'sourceVersion' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_STATE_CHANGED';END IF;
  IF NOT(view_value#>>ARRAY['permissions',CASE WHEN body->>'command'='approve' THEN 'canApprove' ELSE 'canWithdraw' END])::boolean THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_DECISION_INVALID';END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('own-receipt:capacity:v1',0)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_BUSY';END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*) FROM public.own_payroll_receipt_event WHERE tenant_id=(ctx->>'tenantId')::uuid AND source_binding_id=(ctx->>'sourceBindingId')::uuid)>=3000 OR(SELECT coalesce(sum(coalesce(octet_length(le.snapshot::text),0)+octet_length(le.body::text)),0) FROM public.own_payroll_receipt_event le)+coalesce(octet_length(s::text),0)+octet_length(body::text)>268435456 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RECEIPT_LIMIT';END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.own_payroll_receipt_event(id,tenant_id,source_binding_id,batch_id,command,actor_membership_id,actor_person_id,actor_email,actor_label,actor_session_id,actor_session_version,release_sha,request_key,body,body_sha256,snapshot,snapshot_sha256) VALUES(id_value,(ctx->>'tenantId')::uuid,(ctx->>'sourceBindingId')::uuid,batch_value,body->>'command',(ctx->>'membershipId')::uuid,(ctx->>'actorPersonId')::uuid,ctx->>'actorEmail',coalesce(nullif(ctx->>'actorLabel',''),'Autoridad municipal'),(p->>'actorSessionId')::uuid,(p->>'actorSessionVersion')::integer,p->>'releaseSha',key,body,fingerprint,s,hash_value) RETURNING * INTO e;RETURN public.own_receipt_event_v1(e);
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.own_run_quantity_family_v1() RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public,pg_temp AS $c1_provider$
DECLARE expected jsonb:='{"signature":"public.own_run_release_attest_c1_v1(text)","sha256":"e4cde8662c396377307675e03f6c62e64336a4fa991d04f5f0eaae144cf65c27","owner":"neondb_owner","acl":"{neondb_owner=X/neondb_owner}","config":["search_path=pg_catalog, public, pg_temp"],"securityDefiner":true,"volatility":"s","strict":false,"leakproof":false,"parallel":"u","kind":"f","language":"plpgsql","cost":100,"rowsEstimate":0,"resultType":"jsonb","arguments":"kind text","identityArguments":"kind text"}'::jsonb;actual jsonb;family jsonb;members jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'signature',expected->>'signature','sha256',encode(pg_catalog.sha256(convert_to(p.prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex'),
 'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'acl',p.proacl::text,'config',to_jsonb(p.proconfig),
 'securityDefiner',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile::text,'strict',p.proisstrict,
 'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'parallel',p.proparallel::text,'kind',p.prokind::text,
 'language',l.lanname,'cost',p.procost,'rowsEstimate',p.prorows,
 'resultType',pg_get_function_result(p.oid),'arguments',pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),
 'identityArguments',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)) INTO actual
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang
 WHERE p.oid=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(expected->>'signature');
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RUN_FAMILY_ATTESTER_CHANGED'; END IF;
 family:=public.own_run_release_attest_c1_v1('quantity');
 SELECT jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value->>'signature' COLLATE "C") INTO members FROM jsonb_array_elements((family->'members')||jsonb_build_array('{"signature":"public.own_run_release_attest_c1_v1(text)","sha256":"e4cde8662c396377307675e03f6c62e64336a4fa991d04f5f0eaae144cf65c27"}'::jsonb));
 IF jsonb_array_length(members) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 64 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RUN_FAMILY_MEMBER_LIMIT'; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_set(family,'{members}',members);
END
$c1_provider$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.own_run_official_family_v1() RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public,pg_temp AS $c1_provider$
DECLARE expected jsonb:='{"signature":"public.own_run_release_attest_c1_v1(text)","sha256":"e4cde8662c396377307675e03f6c62e64336a4fa991d04f5f0eaae144cf65c27","owner":"neondb_owner","acl":"{neondb_owner=X/neondb_owner}","config":["search_path=pg_catalog, public, pg_temp"],"securityDefiner":true,"volatility":"s","strict":false,"leakproof":false,"parallel":"u","kind":"f","language":"plpgsql","cost":100,"rowsEstimate":0,"resultType":"jsonb","arguments":"kind text","identityArguments":"kind text"}'::jsonb;actual jsonb;family jsonb;members jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'signature',expected->>'signature','sha256',encode(pg_catalog.sha256(convert_to(p.prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex'),
 'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'acl',p.proacl::text,'config',to_jsonb(p.proconfig),
 'securityDefiner',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile::text,'strict',p.proisstrict,
 'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'parallel',p.proparallel::text,'kind',p.prokind::text,
 'language',l.lanname,'cost',p.procost,'rowsEstimate',p.prorows,
 'resultType',pg_get_function_result(p.oid),'arguments',pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),
 'identityArguments',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)) INTO actual
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang
 WHERE p.oid=pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(expected->>'signature');
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RUN_FAMILY_ATTESTER_CHANGED'; END IF;
 family:=public.own_run_release_attest_c1_v1('official');
 SELECT jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value->>'signature' COLLATE "C") INTO members FROM jsonb_array_elements((family->'members')||jsonb_build_array('{"signature":"public.own_run_release_attest_c1_v1(text)","sha256":"e4cde8662c396377307675e03f6c62e64336a4fa991d04f5f0eaae144cf65c27"}'::jsonb));
 IF jsonb_array_length(members) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 64 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWN_RUN_FAMILY_MEMBER_LIMIT'; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_set(family,'{members}',members);
END

 IF (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(g.tgname,g.tgtype,g.tgenabled,g.tgfoid::regprocedure::text) ORDER BY g.tgname),'[]') FROM pg_trigger g WHERE g.tgrelid=t.oid AND NOT g.tgisinternal)<>'[["own_bank_accounts_immutable",27,"O","own_bank_accounts_immutable_v1()"],["own_bank_accounts_no_truncate",34,"O","own_bank_accounts_immutable_v1()"]]'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BANK_ACCOUNTS_IMMUTABLE_GUARD';END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.conrelid=t.oid AND k.contype='f' AND (SELECT count(*)<>4 OR bool_or(g.tgenabled<>'O' OR NOT g.tgisinternal OR g.tgconstrrelid NOT IN(k.conrelid,k.confrelid)) FROM pg_trigger g WHERE g.tgconstraint=k.oid)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BANK_ACCOUNTS_FOREIGN_GUARD';END IF;
 END $shape$;
COMMIT;
